card.title: Can you add the always-ready runner on workshop for zm's quick checks?
card.context: Ivo chose an always-ready runner on workshop for zm's quick checks, so they start in seconds instead of waiting up to 15 minutes for room. Only you can add runners on workshop. It's one small 2-CPU runner, named like the two zm already has there, but kept ready all the time. Once it shows online, an agent points the quick checks at it with one setting, and deleting that setting undoes it.
